037/**
038 * An Alloy model in this JVM and its solutions: claferIG's {@code AlloyIG.java},
039 * whose operations are the methods here rather than messages on a pipe. A
040 * solution is Alloy's XML of it, as {@code AlloyIG} sends it.
041 * <p>
042 * The model is parsed from its text, in memory. The solutions of a dynamic
043 * model, a trace each, are solved for one by one, without the traces given so
044 * far ({@link #next}); {@link #fork} and {@link #nextConfiguration} give
045 * other traces, and {@link #check} the counterexample of an assertion. The
046 * unsat core of the model comes from the minisat prover, claferIG's fixed
047 * one ({@link FixedMiniSatProver}).
048 */
049public final class AlloySession {
050
051    // The only way to detect unsatisfiability is to wait for the minimized callback to be called.
052    // If it is called, then unsatisfiable. Otherwise not. See alloy4whole/SimpleReporter.java.
053    private static final class Reporter extends A4Reporter {
054
055        private int minimizedBefore;
056        private int minimizedAfter;
057
058        @Override
059        public void warning(ErrorWarning msg) {
060            System.err.print("Relevance Warning:\n" + (msg.toString().trim()) + "\n\n");
061            System.err.flush();
062        }
063
064        @Override
065        public void minimized(Object command, int before, int after) {
066            minimizedBefore = before;
067            minimizedAfter = after;
068            super.minimized(command, before, after);
069        }
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * A sig of the model, as {@code load} sends it.
074     *
075     * @param label its label, e.g., {@code this/c0_A}
076     * @param multiplicity {@code One}, {@code Lone}, {@code Some} or
077     * {@code Any}
078     * @param subset the type of a subset sig, without its braces, or empty
079     * @param startingScope its scope in the command, if any
080     */
081    public record SigInfo(String label, String multiplicity, String subset, OptionalInt startingScope) {
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * The sigs of the model and the global scope of its command.
086     */
087    public record Loaded(List<SigInfo> sigs, int globalScope) {
088    }
089
090    static {
091        // Alloy logs its progress at the info level and warns whenever a native solver is garbage collected.
092        if (System.getProperty("org.slf4j.simpleLogger.defaultLogLevel") == null) {
093            System.setProperty("org.slf4j.simpleLogger.defaultLogLevel", "error");
094        }
095    }
096
097    private final Reporter rep = new Reporter();
098    private CompModule world;
099    private SafeList<Sig> sigs;
100    private Command command;
101    // Alloy parses the model from a temporary file; positions only match with its name.
102    private String modelFile = "";
103    private A4Solution ans;
104    // The solution of the model, as solved by the last resolve: if it is unsatisfiable, the
105    // model has no instances, and its unsat core explains why.
106    private A4Solution resolved;
107    private boolean dynamic;
108    // In a dynamic model, the traces given so far are excluded from the next solutions, and the
109    // configurations given so far from the next configuration. The next trace is solved for
110    // when it is asked for, after the trace shown last.
111    private Expr givenTraces = ExprConstant.TRUE;
112    private Expr givenConfigurations = ExprConstant.TRUE;
113    private A4Solution shown;
114    private boolean stale;
115    // the static model gave its last instance
116    private boolean exhausted;
117    private final A4Options options = new A4Options();
118    private Util.State<StateExtra> state;
119
120    public AlloySession() {
121        // Use fastest
122        options.coreMinimization = 2;
123        // The minisat prover computes unsat cores. Alloy has none for Windows, so instances come from SAT4J there.
124        // The optimized build of the prover is given in the system property alloy.native.lib.minisatprover.
125        SATFactory prover = new FixedMiniSatProver.Factory();
126        options.solver = prover.isPresent() ? prover : SATFactory.get("sat4j");
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * {@code load}: parses the model.
131     *
132     * @throws Err the errors of the model
133     */
134    public Loaded load(String model) throws Err {
135        world = CompUtil.parseEverything_fromString(rep, model);
136        sigs = world.getAllSigs();
137        Util.splitFacts(world.getAllReachableSigs());
138        dynamic = isDynamic(sigs);
139        command = world.getAllCommands().get(0);
140        modelFile = command.pos.filename;
141        List<SigInfo> infos = new ArrayList<>();
142        for (Sig sig : sigs) {
143            CommandScope scope = command.getScope(sig);
144            infos.add(new SigInfo(sig.label, multiplicity(sig),
145                    sig instanceof Sig.PrimSig ? "" : removeCurly(sig.type().toString()),
146                    scope == null ? OptionalInt.empty() : OptionalInt.of(scope.startingScope)));
147        }
148        return new Loaded(infos, command.overall);
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * @return whether the model has mutable sigs or fields: its solutions are
153     * traces
154     */
155    public boolean isDynamic() {
156        return dynamic;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * {@code resolve}: solves the command again, from its first solution.
161     */
162    public void resolve() throws Err {
163        rep.minimizedBefore = 0;
164        rep.minimizedAfter = 0;
165        givenTraces = ExprConstant.TRUE;
166        givenConfigurations = ExprConstant.TRUE;
167        shown = null;
168        stale = false;
169        exhausted = false;
170        ans = TranslateAlloyToKodkod.execute_command(rep, world.getAllReachableSigs(), command, options);
171        resolved = ans;
172    }
173
174    /**
175     * {@code next}: the next solution, if any.
176     */
177    public Optional<String> next() throws Err {
178        if (exhausted) {
179            return Optional.empty();
180        }
181        if (dynamic && stale) {
182            // Alloy does not enumerate the traces of a temporal model: it gives few of them,
183            // of the length it found first, or none at all, depending on the model. Instead,
184            // the next trace is solved for, without the traces given so far. The reporter of
185            // the model stays as it is, since no more traces is not an unsat core of the model.
186            ans = TranslateAlloyToKodkod.execute_command(new Reporter(), world.getAllReachableSigs(),
187                    command.change(command.formula.and(givenTraces)), withoutCore(options));
188            stale = false;
189        }
190        if (!ans.satisfiable()) {
191            return Optional.empty();
192        }
193        String xml = toXml(ans);
194        if (dynamic) {
195            List<Sig.Field> fields = stateFields(world.getAllReachableSigs());
196            givenTraces = givenTraces.and(sameStates(ans, visible(fields, fields), ans.getTraceLength(), true).not());
197            givenConfigurations = givenConfigurations.and(
198                    sameStates(ans, visible(staticFields(fields), fields), 1, false).not());
199            shown = ans;
200            stale = true;
201        } else {
202            givenConfigurations = givenConfigurations.and(
203                    sameStates(ans, structure(world.getAllReachableSigs()), 1, false).not());
204            shown = ans;
205            A4Solution nextAns = ans.next();
206            // AlloyIG quits here: the static model has no more instances
207            if (nextAns == ans) {
208                exhausted = true;
209            }
210            ans = nextAns;
211        }
212        return Optional.of(xml);
213    }
214
215    /**
216     * {@code fork}: a trace with the same states as the trace shown last
217     * before the given state, which differs from the traces given so far.
218     */
219    public Optional<String> fork(int forkState) throws Err {
220        return other(true, forkState);
221    }
222
223    /**
224     * {@code nextConfiguration}: a trace whose relations that do not change
225     * over time differ from those of the traces given so far, or an instance
226     * of a static model whose structure differs from those of the instances
227     * given so far.
228     */
229    public Optional<String> nextConfiguration() throws Err {
230        return other(false, 0);
231    }
232
233    private Optional<String> other(boolean fork, int forkState) throws Err {
234        // Both differ from the traces given so far.
235        A4Solution other = null;
236        if ((dynamic || !fork) && shown != null) {
237            List<Sig.Field> fields = stateFields(world.getAllReachableSigs());
238            Expr formula = fork
239                    ? sameStates(shown, visible(fields, fields), forkState, false)
240                    : givenConfigurations;
241            other = TranslateAlloyToKodkod.execute_command(new Reporter(), world.getAllReachableSigs(),
242                    command.change(command.formula.and(givenTraces).and(formula)), withoutCore(options));
243        }
244        if (other == null || !other.satisfiable()) {
245            return Optional.empty();
246        }
247        String xml = toXml(other);
248        List<Sig.Field> fields = stateFields(world.getAllReachableSigs());
249        shown = other;
250        if (dynamic) {
251            givenTraces = givenTraces.and(sameStates(other, visible(fields, fields), other.getTraceLength(), true).not());
252            givenConfigurations = givenConfigurations.and(
253                    sameStates(other, visible(staticFields(fields), fields), 1, false).not());
254            ans = other;
255            stale = true;
256        } else {
257            // the next instances continue from this one, without the configurations so far
258            givenConfigurations = givenConfigurations.and(
259                    sameStates(other, structure(world.getAllReachableSigs()), 1, false).not());
260            ans = other.next();
261            exhausted = ans == other;
262        }
263        return Optional.of(xml);
264    }
265
266    /**
267     * {@code check}: the counterexample of the assertion with the given label,
268     * at the scopes and the trace length of the model, if any. It has no unsat
269     * core. The solutions of the model stay as they are.
270     */
271    public Optional<String> check(String assertion) throws Err {
272        A4Options checkOptions = withoutCore(options);
273        A4Solution counterexample = null;
274        for (Command a : world.getAllCommands()) {
275            if (a.check && a.label.equals(assertion)) {
276                Command c = command;
277                counterexample = TranslateAlloyToKodkod.execute_command(new Reporter(), world.getAllReachableSigs(),
278                        new Command(a.pos, a.nameExpr, a.label, true, c.overall, c.bitwidth, c.maxseq, c.minprefix,
279                                c.maxprefix, a.expects, c.scope, c.additionalExactScopes, a.commandKeyword,
280                                a.formula, a.parent),
281                        checkOptions);
282            }
283        }
284        return counterexample != null && counterexample.satisfiable()
285                ? Optional.of(toXml(counterexample)) : Optional.empty();
286    }

288    /**
289     * {@code setGlobalScope}.
290     */
291    public void setGlobalScope(int scopeSize) {
292        Command c = command;
293        command = new Command(c.pos, c.nameExpr, c.label, c.check, scopeSize, c.bitwidth, c.maxseq, c.minprefix,
294                c.maxprefix, c.expects, c.scope, c.additionalExactScopes, c.commandKeyword, c.formula, c.parent);
295    }

297    /**
298     * {@code setScope}: the scope of the sig with the given label.
299     */
300    public void setScope(String sigName, int scopeSize) throws ErrorSyntax {
301        Sig sig = Util.findSig(sigName, sigs);
302        List<CommandScope> scope = setScopeSize(sig, scopeSize, command.scope);
303        Command c = command;
304        command = new Command(c.pos, c.nameExpr, c.label, c.check, c.overall, c.bitwidth, c.maxseq, c.minprefix,
305                c.maxprefix, c.expects, scope, c.additionalExactScopes, c.commandKeyword, c.formula, c.parent);
306    }

308    /**
309     * {@code setBitwidth}.
310     */
311    public void setBitwidth(int bitwidth) {
312        if (bitwidth < 1) {
313            throw new IllegalArgumentException(bitwidth + " is an invalid bitwidth.");
314        }
315        Command c = command;
316        command = new Command(c.pos, c.nameExpr, c.label, c.check, c.overall, bitwidth, c.maxseq, c.minprefix,
317                c.maxprefix, c.expects, c.scope, c.additionalExactScopes, c.commandKeyword, c.formula, c.parent);
318    }
319
320    /**
321     * {@code setMaxTraceLength}.
322     */
323    public void setMaxTraceLength(int maxTraceLength) {
324        if (maxTraceLength < 1) {
325            throw new IllegalArgumentException(maxTraceLength + " is an invalid trace length.");
326        }
327        command = withTraceLength(command, Math.min(command.minprefix, maxTraceLength), maxTraceLength);
328    }

330    /**
331     * {@code unsatCoreMinimization}: 0 (best), 1 or 2 (fastest).
332     */
333    public void setUnsatCoreMinimization(int level) {
334        if (level < 0 || level > 2) {
335            throw new IllegalArgumentException(level + " is in invalid optimization level.");
336        }
337        options.coreMinimization = level;
338    }

340    /**
341     * {@code saveState}: to generate counterexamples, the model is mutated;
342     * its state is saved first and restored once completed.
343     */
344    public void saveState() {
345        state = Util.saveState(sigs, new StateExtra(rep.minimizedBefore, rep.minimizedAfter, ans, resolved, command,
346                givenTraces, exhausted));
347    }
348
349    /**
350     * {@code restoreState}.
351     */
352    public void restoreState() {
353        StateExtra extra = Util.restoreState(state, sigs);
354        rep.minimizedBefore = extra.minimizedBefore();
355        rep.minimizedAfter = extra.minimizedAfter();
356        ans = extra.answer();
357        resolved = extra.resolved();
358        command = extra.command();
359        givenTraces = extra.givenTraces();
360        exhausted = extra.exhausted();
361    }
362
363    /**
364     * {@code removeConstraint}: the constraint at the span, as the unsat core
365     * gives it (the second column one more than Alloy's).
366     *
367     * @throws IllegalStateException if there is no constraint at the span
368     */
369    public void removeConstraint(int y, int x, int y2, int x2) {
370        // The second column is one less than it should be. Not sure if Alloy bug or intended.
371        Pos constraint = new Pos(modelFile, x, y, x2 - 1, y2);
372        Command newCommand = Util.removeGlobalConstraint(constraint, command);
373        if (newCommand == null) {
374            if (!Util.removeLocalConstraint(constraint, sigs)) {
375                throw new IllegalStateException(String.format(
376                        "Cannot remove constraint (line=%d, column=%d)-(line=%d, column=%d)",
377                        constraint.y, constraint.x, constraint.y2, constraint.x2));
378            }
379        } else {
380            command = newCommand;
381        }
382    }
383
384    /**
385     * {@code unsatCore}: the spans of the constraints of the unsat core of the
386     * model, each as {line, column, line, column + 1}, or none. Only the model
387     * has an unsat core: not the next solution, when the solutions of the
388     * model run out. Alloy reports no minimized core when it finds the model
389     * unsatisfiable without solving, e.g., {@code [ some b ]} and
390     * {@code [ no b ]}, so the core is not checked by its size.
391     */
392    public List<int[]> unsatCore() {
393        List<int[]> core = new ArrayList<>();
394        if (ans == resolved && !ans.satisfiable()) {
395            Set<Pos> unsatCore = ans.highLevelCore().a;
396            for (Pos p : unsatCore) {
397                // The second column is one less than it should be.
398                core.add(new int[]{p.y, p.x, p.y2, p.x2 + 1});
399            }
400        }
401        return core;
402    }

404    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
405    // AlloyIG's helpers
406    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
407    private record StateExtra(int minimizedBefore, int minimizedAfter, A4Solution answer, A4Solution resolved,
408            Command command, Expr givenTraces, boolean exhausted) {
409    }
410
411    private static CommandScope setCommandScopeSize(int scopeSize, CommandScope cs) throws ErrorSyntax {
412        return new CommandScope(cs.pos, cs.sigPos, cs.sig, cs.isExact, scopeSize, scopeSize, cs.increment);
413    }
414
415    private static List<CommandScope> setScopeSize(Sig sig, int scopeSize, List<CommandScope> scope)
416            throws ErrorSyntax {
417        List<CommandScope> newScope = new ArrayList<>();
418        boolean found = false;
419        for (CommandScope cs : scope) {
420            if (sig.equals(cs.sig)) {
421                found = true;
422                newScope.add(setCommandScopeSize(scopeSize, cs));
423            } else {
424                newScope.add(cs);
425            }
426        }
427        if (!found) {
428            newScope.add(new CommandScope(sig, false, scopeSize));
429        }
430        return newScope;
431    }
432
433    private static String toXml(A4Solution ans) throws Err {
434        StringWriter xml = new StringWriter();
435        ans.writeXML(new PrintWriter(xml), Collections.<Func>emptyList(), null);
436        return xml.toString();
437    }
438
439    // A dynamic model has mutable sigs or fields; its solutions are traces.
440    private static boolean isDynamic(SafeList<Sig> sigs) {
441        for (Sig sig : sigs) {
442            if (sig.isVariable != null) {
443                return true;
444            }
445            for (Sig.Field field : sig.getFields()) {
446                if (field.isVariable != null) {
447                    return true;
448                }
449            }
450        }
451        return false;
452    }
453
454    // The relations of the instance in a state of a trace: the containment relations of the
455    // clafers (r_c0_name) and their references (c0_name_ref).
456    private static List<Sig.Field> stateFields(Iterable<Sig> sigs) {
457        List<Sig.Field> fields = new ArrayList<>();
458        for (Sig sig : sigs) {
459            for (Sig.Field field : sig.getFields()) {
460                if (field.label.startsWith("r_") || field.label.endsWith("_ref")) {
461                    fields.add(field);
462                }
463            }
464        }
465        return fields;
466    }
467
468    // The given relations as they are seen in a state: the references of the clafers in it. The
469    // model constrains a reference only while its clafer is alive, so a clafer that is not in the
470    // state has any value, and a trace that differs only in such values is the same trace. A
471    // clafer is alive when it is the child of a clafer, which is alive itself (the parent of
472    // each child is alive in the model).
473    private static List<Expr> visible(List<Sig.Field> fields, List<Sig.Field> all) {
474        Expr alive = null;
475        for (Sig.Field field : all) {
476            if (field.label.startsWith("r_")) {
477                Expr children = Sig.UNIV.join(field);
478                alive = alive == null ? children : alive.plus(children);
479            }
480        }
481        List<Expr> visible = new ArrayList<>();
482        for (Sig.Field field : fields) {
483            visible.add(alive != null && field.label.endsWith("_ref") ? alive.domain(field) : field);
484        }
485        return visible;
486    }
487
488    // The expression applied n times.
489    private static Expr repeat(Expr e, int n, boolean prime) {
490        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
491            e = prime ? e.prime() : e.after();
492        }
493        return e;
494    }
495
496    // The expression of an atom: the sig of a one sig, a number, or a variable for the atom.
497    private static Expr atom(String label, Sig.PrimSig sig, Map<String, Decl> vars) throws Err {
498        if (sig.isOne != null) {
499            return sig;
500        }
501        if (sig.builtin) {
502            return ExprConstant.makeNUMBER(Integer.parseInt(label));
503        }
504        Decl decl = vars.get(label);
505        if (decl == null) {
506            decl = sig.oneOf("atom" + vars.size());
507            vars.put(label, decl);
508        }
509        return decl.get();
510    }
511
512    // The relations of a configuration of a dynamic model, which do not change over time.
513    private static List<Sig.Field> staticFields(List<Sig.Field> fields) {
514        List<Sig.Field> statics = new ArrayList<>();
515        for (Sig.Field field : fields) {
516            if (field.isVariable == null) {
517                statics.add(field);
518            }
519        }
520        return statics;
521    }
522
523    // The relations of a configuration of a static model: its structure, which clafers there
524    // are, without the values of its references. A top-level clafer has no parent relation,
525    // so the sigs say which clafers there are.
526    private static List<Expr> structure(Iterable<Sig> sigs) {
527        List<Expr> structure = new ArrayList<>();
528        for (Sig sig : sigs) {
529            if (!sig.builtin && sig.isAbstract == null) {
530                structure.add(sig);
531            }
532            for (Sig.Field field : sig.getFields()) {
533                if (field.label.startsWith("r_")) {
534                    structure.add(field);
535                }
536            }
537        }
538        return structure;
539    }
540
541    // Some distinct atoms make the given relations in the first states of the trace equal to those
542    // of the given trace, up to a renaming of its atoms; with the loop, from the loop state, the
543    // trace repeats the loop, so that it is the given trace.
544    private static Expr sameStates(A4Solution ans, List<? extends Expr> fields, int count, boolean withLoop)
545            throws Err {
546        Map<String, Decl> vars = new LinkedHashMap<>();
547        // an instance of a static model has no trace, but it is one state
548        int length = Math.max(ans.getTraceLength(), 1);
549        int loop = ans.getLoopState();
550        Expr trace = ExprConstant.TRUE;
551        for (int s = Math.min(count, length) - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
552            Expr st = ExprConstant.TRUE;
553            for (Expr field : fields) {
554                Expr value = null;
555                for (A4Tuple tuple : (A4TupleSet) ans.eval(field, s)) {
556                    Expr t = null;
557                    for (int i = 0; i < tuple.arity(); i++) {
558                        Expr a = atom(tuple.atom(i), tuple.sig(i), vars);
559                        t = t == null ? a : t.product(a);
560                    }
561                    value = value == null ? t : value.plus(t);
562                }
563                st = st.and(value == null ? field.no() : field.equal(value));
564            }
565            trace = s == Math.min(count, length) - 1 ? st : st.and(trace.after());
566        }
567        if (withLoop) {
568            Expr periodic = ExprConstant.TRUE;
569            for (Expr field : fields) {
570                periodic = periodic.and(field.equal(repeat(field, length - loop, true)));
571            }
572            trace = trace.and(repeat(periodic.always(), loop, false));
573        }
574        List<Decl> decls = new ArrayList<>(vars.values());
575        for (int i = 0; i < decls.size(); i++) {
576            for (int j = i + 1; j < decls.size(); j++) {
577                trace = decls.get(i).get().equal(decls.get(j).get()).not().and(trace);
578            }
579        }
580        return decls.isEmpty() ? trace : ExprQt.Op.SOME.make(Pos.UNKNOWN, Pos.UNKNOWN, decls, trace);
581    }
582
583    // The command with the given bounds of the trace length.
584    private static Command withTraceLength(Command c, int minTraceLength, int maxTraceLength) {
585        return new Command(c.pos, c.nameExpr, c.label, c.check, c.overall, c.bitwidth, c.maxseq, minTraceLength,
586                maxTraceLength, c.expects, c.scope, c.additionalExactScopes, c.commandKeyword, c.formula, c.parent);
587    }
588
589    private static String multiplicity(Sig sig) {
590        if (sig.isOne != null) {
591            return "One";
592        } else if (sig.isLone != null) {
593            return "Lone";
594        } else if (sig.isSome != null) {
595            return "Some";
596        }
597        return "Any";
598    }
599
600    // The options for a solve whose unsatisfiability is not shown as an unsat core: a check, and the next
601    // trace, fork or configuration. The solver is not the prover, which logs the translation to a file for
602    // an unsat core; that log of a large model can take gigabytes, more than a temporary folder holds.
603    private static A4Options withoutCore(A4Options options) {
604        A4Options without = options.dup();
605        SATFactory minisat = SATFactory.get("minisat");
606        without.solver = minisat.isPresent() ? minisat : SATFactory.get("sat4j");
607        return without;
608    }
609
610    private static String removeCurly(String string) {
611        int length = string.length();
612        if (length > 0 && string.charAt(0) == '{' && string.charAt(length - 1) == '}') {
613            return string.substring(1, length - 1);
614        }
615        throw new IllegalArgumentException("\"" + string + "\" is not surrounded by curly brackets.");
616    }
617}
